rationale: The core entry thesis has structurally broken down: price has slipped below both the session VWAP ($14.80) and the 9-EMA ($14.76), the two pillars cited at entry, and is now only $0.02 above the original invalidation level of $14.72 with five consecutive lower-close candles showing no buying support. Volume on the most recent candle collapsed to 617 shares, signaling the relative-volume spike that drove the entry has faded rather than accelerating the expected breakout, making holding an asymmetrically poor risk/reward ahead of an almost-certain stop-out.
